bull.narrative: Seagate Technology Holdings plc experiences a decade-long growth in data storage needs, maintaining its competitive advantage through scale and brand. Revenue and market cap grow at a compound annual growth rate of 10%.

base.narrative: Seagate Technology Holdings plc experiences a decade-long stable growth in data storage needs, maintaining its competitive advantage through scale and brand. Revenue and market cap grow at a compound annual growth rate of 5%.

bear.narrative: Seagate Technology Holdings plc experiences a decade-long decline in data storage needs, losing its competitive advantage due to increased competition and technological advancements. Revenue and market cap decline at a compound annual growth rate of 10%.

tracking_note: Short-term price moves, news cycles, and 8-K noise will not structurally change the next decade.
thesis_breaks_if: Short-term price moves, news cycles, and 8-K noise, unless they structurally change the next decade.
